name: @chainaim/actus
description: ACTUS cash flows for fixed-rate loans (PAM bullet, ANN equal instalments): terms -> ACTUS contract, run on ACTUS directly or through ACTUS Mentor, checked, and turned into schedule rows; terms read by a model are checked against the document's own text. Pure apart from fetch. No runtime dependencies.

scripts.golden:check: node ../../tools/golden/golden.ts --mode check --module src/index.ts --cases test/golden/cases.json --golden test/golden/actus.golden.json --skip runDirect,mentorBuild,mentorRun
scripts.golden:record: node ../../tools/golden/golden.ts --mode record --module src/index.ts --cases test/golden/cases.json --golden test/golden/actus.golden.json --skip runDirect,mentorBuild,mentorRun
